title: Retain empty multipart fields exactly once, including the final field
summary: The servlet multipart converter now returns both an empty first field and an empty last field. Three fields under one name retained order and cardinality.

change.description: The servlet-side converter finishes the current part at the next part boundary and at end of input. Its completion guard also protects parts already emitted on a final body buffer.

notes: Both original CRLF resources come from the pinned test tree. A separate wire fixture repeats the same name with empty, nonempty and empty bodies.
